recs.rel: Fact: Islamabad has been the capital of Pakistan since 1960s, before that Karachi was the capital.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q16) My mother is your brother's sister. What am I to you?
recs.facts: Your brother's sister is your sister, so my mother is your sister and I am your nephew.
recs.rel: Tip: in relation puzzles, translate each phrase into a simple relation one step at a time.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q17) Kamal is older than Jamal, Jamal is older than Hussain, Hussain is older than Waqar. Who is the oldest?
recs.facts: The order is Kamal, Jamal, Hussain, Waqar from oldest to youngest.
recs.rel: Tip: write the names in a line from oldest to youngest to check ranking questions.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q18) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: High, great, fat and big all suggest large size. Small is the opposite.
recs.rel: Tip: in odd-one-out questions, find the property shared by most words and pick the one that breaks it.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q19) What will come next in the following series? 2, 4, 8, 14, ?
recs.facts: The differences are 2, 4, 6, so the next difference is 8: 14 + 8 = 22.
recs.rel: Tip: for number series, check the differences, then the ratios, then alternating patterns.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q20) What will come next in the following series? 34, 24, 16, 10, 6, ?
recs.facts: The differences are 10, 8, 6, 4, so the next difference is 2: 6 - 2 = 4.
recs.rel: Tip: for number series, check the differences, then the ratios, then alternating patterns.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q22) Which one is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Relationship, kinship and friendship are all human bonds. Spaceship is a vehicle.
recs.rel: Tip: words with the same ending may still belong to different categories, so check the meaning.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q23) Akmal and Jamal are brothers, Anjum and Ajmal are their sons. What is the relation between Anjum and Ajmal?
recs.facts: Anjum and Ajmal are sons of two brothers, so they are cousins.
recs.rel: Fact: children of two brothers are called paternal cousins.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q24) Which one is different from the rest? Oxygen, Sulphur, Silver, Zinc, Protenium
recs.facts: Oxygen is a gas at room temperature, while sulphur, silver and zinc are solids (the printed Protenium is not a standard element name). The answer key also gives Oxygen.
recs.rel: Tip: if one item is a gas and the rest are solids, the gas is the odd one.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q25) A grandfather is always ____ than his daughter.
recs.facts: A grandfather is older than his daughter, which means he has lived longer and is more experienced. Taller, wiser and heavier are not always true.
recs.rel: Tip: choose the quality that must hold in every case, not one that merely may hold.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q27) If 18:00 o'clock is to 6 o'clock, then 14:00 o'clock is to ____ o'clock.
recs.facts: 18:00 on the 24-hour clock is 6 on a 12-hour clock (18 - 12). Likewise 14:00 is 2 o'clock.
recs.rel: Tip: subtract 12 from any 24-hour time after 12:00 to get the 12-hour time.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q28) Which one is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Confuse, puzzle, disturb and tense relate to being troubled or perplexed. Advancing means moving forward.
recs.rel: Tip: in odd-one-out questions, find the property shared by most words and pick the one that breaks it.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q29) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Dagger, sword and knife are cutting weapons. A fork is an eating tool without a blade.
recs.rel: Tip: in odd-one-out questions, find the property shared by most words and pick the one that breaks it.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 3 · Q30) Which one is different from the rest? AC, DG, HK, LO
recs.facts: In DG, HK and LO the second letter is 3 places after the first. In AC it is only 2 places.
recs.rel: Tip: for letter series, convert letters to numbers (A=1 to Z=26) and look at the gaps.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q1) Which comes next in the following series? A, B, C, D, E, ?

recs.rel: Tip: for letter series, convert letters to numbers (A=1 to Z=26) and look at the gaps.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q2) Which number comes next in the following series? 64, 32, 16, 8, ?
recs.facts: Each term is half of the one before: 8 / 2 = 4.
recs.rel: Tip: for number series, check the differences, then the ratios, then alternating patterns.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q3) Add the smallest and the largest numbers and divide the total by the third number. The numbers are 3, 6, 15.
recs.facts: Smallest 3 plus largest 15 is 18. The third number is 6, and 18 / 6 = 3.
recs.rel: Tip: the third number means the third in the printed order, not the third largest.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q4) STONE is to HARD as COTTON WOOL is to:
recs.facts: A stone is characterised by being hard, and cotton wool by being soft.
recs.rel: Tip: in analogies, name the quality that links the first pair.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q5) DEAL is to 7345 as LEAD is to:
recs.facts: D=7, E=3, A=4, L=5. LEAD is L, E, A, D = 5, 3, 4, 7, which gives 5347.
recs.rel: Tip: in word-code questions, write the code letter under each letter, then re-use the same mapping for the new word.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q6) Tree is to branches as river is to:
recs.facts: Branches spread out from a tree, and canals are channels taken off a river. This matches the answer key (a delta could also be argued).
recs.rel: Tip: when two options seem close, pick the one that fits the relationship in the first pair most directly.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q8) Which letter comes next in the following series? A, C, E, G, I, ?
recs.facts: Every second letter is taken, so after I comes K.
recs.rel: Tip: for letter series, convert letters to numbers (A=1 to Z=26) and look at the gaps.

recs.facts: The differences are -5, -10, -15, so the next is -20: 25 - 20 = 5.
recs.rel: Tip: for number series, check the differences, then the ratios, then alternating patterns.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q10) What is the total cost of two pencils at Rs.2 each and one dozen sharpeners at Rs.3 each?
recs.facts: Pencils cost 2 x 2 = 4. A dozen sharpeners cost 12 x 3 = 36. The total is 40.
recs.rel: Tip: one dozen means 12 items.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q11) If Akram is older than Kamal and Hamid is younger than Kamal but Amjad is older than Hamid, who is the youngest?
recs.facts: Hamid is younger than Kamal and Amjad, and Kamal is younger than Akram, so Hamid is the youngest.
recs.rel: Tip: write the names in a line from oldest to youngest to check ranking questions.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q12) Write the letter that is as far from the beginning of the alphabet as D is from the beginning of the word PROUDLY.
recs.facts: In PROUDLY, D is the 5th letter (P, R, O, U, D). The 5th letter of the alphabet is E.
recs.rel: Tip: count the position in the word first and then use that number in the alphabet.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q13) Which letter comes next in the following series? A, D, G, J, M, ?

recs.rel: Tip: quantity = money divided by price per unit.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q16) Sweet is to sour as cold is to:
recs.facts: Sweet and sour are opposites, and the opposite of cold is hot.
recs.rel: Tip: check whether an analogy is about opposites or about synonyms.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q17) Which one of the following is different from others?
recs.facts: Salmon, crab, shark and whale are all specific sea animals, while Fish is the general category name. This follows the answer key (whale is also not a true fish).
recs.rel: Tip: in odd-one-out questions, find the property shared by most words and pick the one that breaks it.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q18) Which letter comes next in the following series? B, F, I, M, P, ?

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q19) A bakery sells a mixture of 2 parts cream and 3 parts milk. How many litres of cream will it take to make 15 litres of the mixture?
recs.facts: The mixture has 5 parts in total, so one part is 3 litres. Cream is 2 parts: 2 x 3 = 6 litres.
recs.rel: Tip: add the parts of a ratio first, then divide the total by that sum.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q20) Kund, Mora and Mokoma are three cities. Mora is 120 km in the west of Kund and Mokoma is 320 km in the North of Mora. Then Kund is in the ____ of Mokoma.
recs.facts: Mokoma is directly north of Mora, and Kund is east of Mora. So Kund is to the south and east of Mokoma, which is South East.
recs.rel: Tip: sketch a quick map with north at the top.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q22) How many packs of envelopes can be bought for Rs.3 at the rate of 50 paisa each?
recs.facts: Rs.3 is 300 paisa, and 300 / 50 = 6 packs.
recs.rel: Fact: 1 rupee equals 100 paisa.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q23) In a college, out of 200 students 45% study Physics and 65% study Maths. Are there any students who neither study Physics nor Maths?
recs.facts: Physics has 90 students and Maths 130, a total of 220, so at least 20 study both. If exactly 20 study both there are none who study neither, but if more study both there are some. The answer cannot be fixed (the paper key says Yes).
recs.rel: Tip: when overlap is unknown, the number outside both sets can vary.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q26) Which one of the following is different from the others?
recs.facts: Brazil, Canada, Chile and Argentina are countries. New York is a city.

recs.rel: Tip: for number series, check the differences, then the ratios, then alternating patterns.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q28) All animals have tails. Some birds have tails. X has a tail, therefore it is a bird:
recs.facts: Having a tail does not prove it is a bird, since every animal has a tail. So the conclusion is uncertain.
recs.rel: Tip: a shared feature never proves membership of a smaller group.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 4 · Q29) A car is travelling at the speed of 120 km per hour. How many minutes will it take to travel 24 km?
recs.facts: 120 km per hour is 2 km per minute, so 24 km takes 24 / 2 = 12 minutes.
recs.rel: Tip: convert km per hour to km per minute by dividing by 60.

recs.facts: The ten empty boxes weigh 10 x 3 = 30 kg. The oranges weigh 120 - 30 = 90 kg.
recs.rel: Tip: subtract the packaging weight to get the net weight.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 5 · Q11) If Imran is older than Waseem and Kaleem is younger than Imran, which of the following statements is true?
opts: Waseem and Kaleem are of equal age
recs.facts: Imran is older than both Waseem and Kaleem, so he is the oldest. The relative ages of Waseem and Kaleem are not known.
recs.rel: Tip: only accept statements that follow from the facts given.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 5 · Q12) How many letters in the word GENERAL are also found in the word REGULAR?
recs.facts: The letters G, E, R, A and L of GENERAL appear in REGULAR, while N does not. That gives 5 letters.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 5 · Q15) If one shirt can be made with 2 1/3 metres of cloth, how many shirts can be made from 14 metres of cloth?
recs.facts: 2 1/3 is 7/3. Then 14 divided by 7/3 is 14 x 3/7 = 6.
recs.rel: Tip: convert mixed fractions to improper fractions before dividing.

recs.facts: The total distance is 4 + 11 = 15 km and the total time is 1.5 hours. Speed = 15 / 1.5 = 10 km per hour.

recs.facts: In 30 minutes at 90 km per hour it goes 45 km. In 50 minutes at 120 km per hour it goes 100 km. The total is 145 km.

recs.facts: The steps alternate +2 and +1: A, C (+2), D (+1), F (+2), G (+1), so the next is I (+2).
recs.rel: Tip: for letter series, convert letters to numbers (A=1 to Z=26) and look at the gaps.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q19) If 4 pencils cost Rs.7.5, how many can you buy for Rs.15.00?
recs.facts: Rs.15 is double Rs.7.5, so you can buy double the pencils: 8.
recs.rel: Tip: use the unitary or proportion method for price questions.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q20) If Kamran is a brother of Najma and Najma is a daughter of Nasir, then:
opts: Nasir is the father of Kamran
Kamran is the father of Nasir
recs.facts: Najma is Nasir's daughter and Kamran is Najma's brother, so Kamran is also Nasir's child and Nasir is his father.
recs.rel: Tip: siblings share the same parents.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q21) Which letter comes next in the following series? A, D, G, J, M, ?
recs.facts: The letters go up by 3 each time, so M + 3 = P.
recs.rel: Tip: for letter series, convert letters to numbers (A=1 to Z=26) and look at the gaps.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q22) A shopkeeper bought 12 dozens eggs for Rs.360. Two dozen eggs were rotten therefore they could not be sold. What should he charge per dozen for the rest of the eggs to earn a profit of 25% on the whole investment?
recs.facts: The target sale amount is 360 x 1.25 = Rs.450. Only 10 dozen can be sold, so the price is 450 / 10 = Rs.45 per dozen.
recs.rel: Tip: base the profit on the whole investment, then divide by the quantity that can be sold.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q23) If Akram is taller than Saeed and Saeed is shorter than Kazim, may Kazim be as tall as Akram?
recs.facts: Both Akram and Kazim are taller than Saeed, but nothing says Kazim cannot match Akram, so it is possible.
recs.rel: Tip: may be asks whether something is possible, not certain.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q24) Which number comes next? 360, 72, 18, 6, ?
recs.rel: Tip: for number series, check the differences, then the ratios, then alternating patterns.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q25) OPEN is to CLOSE as FAR is to:
recs.facts: Open and close are opposites, and the opposite of far is near.
recs.rel: Tip: check whether an analogy is about opposites or about synonyms.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q26) CATERING is to 21436895 as GREAT is to:
recs.rel: Tip: in word-code questions, write the code letter under each letter, then re-use the same mapping for the new word.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q27) Which number comes next? 100, 9, 64, 7, 36, ?
recs.facts: The terms alternate between two series: 100, 64, 36 (squares of 10, 8, 6) and 9, 7, then 5.
recs.rel: Tip: in alternating series, split the terms into two separate sequences.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q28) Hamid is the same age as Azra. Azra is younger than Zubair, therefore, Zubair is older than Hamid?
recs.facts: Hamid equals Azra in age and Zubair is older than Azra, so Zubair is older than Hamid.
recs.rel: Tip: equal ages can be substituted for one another.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q29) A trader earned 12.5% profit in a year on his whole investment. After this profit he had Rs.1000. If he earns the same rate of profit next year, what will be his total capital?
recs.facts: After the first year his capital is Rs.1000. A 12.5% profit adds Rs.125, giving Rs.1125.
recs.rel: Tip: 12.5% equals one eighth.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 6 · Q30) LEGS are to RUNNING as TEETH are to:
recs.facts: Legs are the body part used for running, and teeth are used for biting. This matches the answer key (eating is a close second).
recs.rel: Tip: pick the action most directly performed by the body part.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q1) Which letter comes next in the following series: C, F, J, M, Q, ?
recs.facts: The gaps alternate +3, +4: C to F is 3, F to J is 4, J to M is 3, M to Q is 4. Next gap is +3, so Q + 3 = T.
recs.rel: Tip: when letter gaps repeat in a pattern, write each letter as a number (A=1) and look at the differences.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q2) Which number comes next: 51, 41, 33, 27, ?
recs.facts: Differences are -10, -8, -6, so the next difference is -4: 27 - 4 = 23.
recs.rel: Tip: when the differences themselves change by a constant amount, the series is a second-order pattern.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q3) Two traders earned a profit of Rs.160. One got 70%. How many rupees did the other get?
recs.facts: The other trader gets 100% - 70% = 30% of 160, which is 0.30 x 160 = 48.
recs.rel: Tip: when shares of a total are given in percent, the remaining share is simply 100 minus the known percent.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q4) NORTH is to 51398 as THORN is to:
recs.rel: Tip: in coding questions, first write down the letter-to-digit table from the given word, then re-read it for the new word.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q6) LOST means the opposite of:
recs.facts: The opposite of lost (misplaced) is found.
recs.rel: Tip: check the part of speech first, because the opposite of a word in a sentence must fit the same sense.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q7) Sky is to Earth as Ceiling is to:
recs.facts: The sky is above the earth; a ceiling is above the floor, so the pairing matches.
recs.rel: Tip: in analogies, state the relationship in a sentence first (above / below, part / whole) and then apply it.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q8) Which letter comes next in the following series: D, G, J, M, P, ?
recs.facts: Each letter moves forward by 3: D, G, J, M, P, then P + 3 = S.
recs.rel: Tip: a constant gap between letters means a simple arithmetic pattern; count the skipped letters carefully.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q9) Which number comes next: 43, 33, 38, 30, 34, ?
recs.facts: The changes alternate and shrink: -10, +5, -8, +4, then -6. So 34 - 6 = 28.
recs.rel: Tip: if the numbers zigzag, look at the differences between neighbours; they may form two separate patterns.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q10) A trader invested Rs.2490 in a business but he had a loss of 100/3 percent. What was he left with after the loss?
recs.facts: 100/3 percent is one third. A third of 2490 is 830, so he was left with 2490 - 830 = 1660.
recs.rel: Tip: 33 and one third percent is the same as the fraction one third, which makes mental maths easy.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q11) Iqbal, Asif and Mahmood are standing in a row. Iqbal is standing in front of Mahmood. Asif is standing behind Iqbal. Mahmood is standing in front of Asif. Who is standing in the middle?
recs.facts: The order from the front is Iqbal, then Mahmood, then Asif, so Mahmood is in the middle.
recs.rel: Tip: draw a quick line of positions and place each person as the clues are read.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q12) Teachers are respected because:
opts: They look after their families well
recs.facts: Teachers are respected mainly for their service of educating children and shaping society.
recs.rel: Tip: in reasoning questions choose the cause most directly linked to the role itself.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q13) Which letter comes next in the following series: D, H, M, P, U, ?
recs.facts: Split the series into two: D, M, U (gaps +9, +8) and H, P, then W (gaps +8, +7). The next letter is W.
recs.rel: Tip: in alternating letter series, separate the odd and even positions into two sequences.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q14) A meal always involves:
recs.facts: A meal by definition consists of food; the other items may or may not be present.
recs.rel: Tip: choose the item that is essential, not just commonly present.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q15) Three shareholders earned a profit of Rs.900 in their business. One got 20% of the profit, the other got 45% of the profit. How many rupees were the share of the third?
recs.facts: The third gets 100 - 20 - 45 = 35 percent, and 35 percent of 900 is 315.
recs.rel: Tip: subtract the given percentages from 100 first, then take the remaining percent of the total.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q16) OCTOBER is to NOVEMBER as SUNDAY is to:
recs.facts: November is the month that follows October, and Monday is the day that follows Sunday.
recs.rel: Tip: time-sequence analogies usually ask for the next item in the cycle.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q17) SICK means the same as:
recs.facts: Sick and ill are synonyms.
recs.rel: Tip: a symptom such as fever or cough is not a synonym; look for a word that can replace the original in any sentence.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q18) Which letter comes next in the following series: A, E, I, M, Q, ?
recs.facts: Each letter is 4 places after the previous one: Q + 4 = U.
recs.rel: Tip: A, E, I, M, Q, U steps by four; the vowels A, E, I appear because 4 happens to land on them early.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q19) Travelling at a speed of 120 km/hour, how much time would be taken to cover a road that is 24 km long?
recs.facts: Time = distance / speed = 24 / 120 = 0.2 hour, which is 0.2 x 60 = 12 minutes.
recs.rel: Tip: remember time = distance divided by speed, and convert hours to minutes by multiplying by 60.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q20) In a class of 100 students, 40% failed in English and 70% in Urdu. Were there any who failed both in English and Urdu?
recs.facts: 40 + 70 = 110, which is more than 100 students, so at least 10 students must have failed both subjects.
recs.rel: Tip: if the percentages of two groups add up to more than 100, the groups must overlap.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q21) Which letter comes next in the following series: R, O, L, I, F, ?
recs.facts: Each letter moves back by 3: R, O, L, I, F, then F - 3 = C.
recs.rel: Tip: a series can run backwards through the alphabet; watch for a constant negative gap.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q22) Kalam lifted 20kg more than Kalim. Shakir lifted more than Kalim. Sabir lifted less than Shakir. Is it possible that Shakir and Sabir lifted the same amount of load?
recs.facts: Sabir lifted less than Shakir, so they cannot have lifted the same amount.
recs.rel: Tip: a statement using less than or more than rules out equality directly.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q23) If Aslam is taller than Hafeez and Hafeez is shorter than Mani, then Aslam is the tallest:
recs.facts: We know Aslam is above Hafeez and Mani is above Hafeez, but Aslam and Mani are not compared, so we cannot tell who is tallest.
recs.rel: Tip: a conclusion is certain only if every comparison needed is stated in the premises.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q24) Which number comes next: 2500, 500, 100, 20, ?
recs.facts: Each number is divided by 5: 2500, 500, 100, 20, then 20 / 5 = 4.
recs.rel: Tip: when numbers fall fast, test division before subtraction.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q25) What is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Swim, walk, run and gymnastic are physical exercises or movements, while game is a general term for a competitive activity.
recs.rel: Tip: look for the item that is a broader category than the rest.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q26) NEAR means the opposite of:
recs.facts: The opposite of near is far.
recs.rel: Tip: avoid synonyms such as close, which mean the same thing, when an opposite is asked.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q27) Which number comes next: 92, 46, 48, 24, 26, ?
recs.facts: The pattern alternates: divide by 2, then add 2. 92 / 2 = 46, +2 = 48, /2 = 24, +2 = 26, /2 = 13.
recs.rel: Tip: alternating operations (divide, then add) are common; test each step separately.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q28) All birds have wings. Some insects have wings. X has wings, therefore it is a bird?
recs.facts: Having wings is shared by birds and some insects, so X could be either; we cannot conclude it is a bird.
recs.rel: Tip: from all A are B you cannot reverse to all B are A.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q29) What will be the area of a rectangle that is 16 feet long and 12 feet wide?
recs.facts: Area = length x width = 16 x 12 = 192 square feet.
recs.rel: Tip: area is length times width, while 2 x (length + width) is the perimeter.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 7 · Q30) ARMY is to SOLDIER as NAVY is to:
recs.facts: A soldier serves in the army and a sailor serves in the navy.
recs.rel: Tip: in this analogy the second word is the ordinary member of the first.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q1) Which letter comes next in the following series: S, Q, N, L, I, ?
recs.facts: Gaps alternate -2, -3: S to Q is 2, Q to N is 3, N to L is 2, L to I is 3, then -2 gives G.
recs.rel: Tip: alternating gaps in letter series repeat in pairs; list the gaps.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q2) Which number comes next: 28, 19, 12, 7, ?
recs.facts: Differences are -9, -7, -5, so the next is -3: 7 - 3 = 4.
recs.rel: Tip: the differences decrease by 2 each time, a typical second-order series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q3) Three oranges cost Rs.6. How much will 1 and a half dozen cost?
recs.facts: One orange costs Rs.2. One and a half dozen is 18 oranges, so 18 x 2 = Rs.36.
recs.rel: Tip: find the unit price first, and remember a dozen is 12.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q4) AGREED is to 157224 as GEARED is to:
recs.rel: Tip: repeated letters, like the two E's, must give the same digit.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q5) NARROW is to WIDE as THIN is to:
recs.facts: Narrow and wide are opposites, and the opposite of thin is fat.
recs.rel: Tip: first decide whether the relation is synonym or antonym.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q6) WAR means the opposite of:
recs.facts: The opposite of war is peace.
recs.rel: Tip: the opposite of war-like states such as conflict is peace, not merely happiness.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q7) Which of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Yacht, steamer and ship travel on water, while an aircraft travels in the air.
recs.rel: Tip: group items by the medium they operate in (land, water, air).

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q8) Which letter comes next in the following series: X, T, P, L, H, ?
recs.facts: Each letter moves back by 4: X, T, P, L, H, then H - 4 = D.
recs.rel: Tip: count backwards carefully when letters step down.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q9) Which number comes next: 229, 222, 37, 32, 8, ?
recs.facts: The numbers fall in pairs by 7, 5 and 3: 229 - 7 = 222, 37 - 5 = 32, so 8 - 3 = 5.
recs.rel: Tip: the amount subtracted shrinks by 2 each pair (7, 5, 3).

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q10) What is the area of a rectangle that is 6 feet long and 4 feet wide?
recs.facts: Area = 6 x 4 = 24 square feet.
recs.rel: Tip: perimeter would be 2 x (6 + 4) = 20, a common wrong answer.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q11) If Ahmed is older than Kamal and Kamal is younger than Imran, then Ahmed is:
recs.facts: Both Ahmed and Imran are older than Kamal, but Ahmed and Imran are not compared directly.
recs.rel: Tip: two people both above a third cannot be ranked against each other.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q12) Sun gives light because:
recs.facts: The sun is a star where nuclear reactions heat gases so strongly that they glow and give off light.
recs.rel: Tip: the sun's energy comes from nuclear fusion of hydrogen into helium.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q13) Which letter comes next in the following series: A, Z, B, Y, C, ?
recs.facts: Two series run together: A, B, C going forward and Z, Y, X going backward. After C comes X.
recs.rel: Tip: when letters jump from the start to the end of the alphabet, think of two interleaved series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q14) A mother is always (?) than her daughter:
recs.facts: A mother is always older than her daughter; the other qualities may differ.
recs.rel: Tip: choose the quality guaranteed by the relationship itself.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q15) Which one of the following is the smallest?
recs.facts: Comparing the values: 0.073 is less than 0.1, 0.73, 7.3 and 73, so it is smallest.
recs.rel: Tip: compare decimals place by place; more leading zeros means a smaller number.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q16) Tail is to ANIMAL as Beak is to:
recs.facts: A tail is a body part of an animal and a beak is a body part of a bird.
recs.rel: Tip: part-to-whole analogies pair a body part with the creature that has it.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q17) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Crow, parrot, owl and sparrow are birds, while a lion is a mammal.
recs.rel: Tip: check class (bird, mammal, fish) when animals are listed.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q18) Which letter comes next in the following series: H, J, K, M, N, ?
recs.facts: The gaps alternate +2, +1: H to J is 2, J to K is 1, K to M is 2, M to N is 1, so N + 2 = P.
recs.rel: Tip: write down each gap and look for the repeating pair.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q19) A man had a wife, two sons and their wives and two grandsons. How many were they in all?
recs.facts: Man 1 + wife 1 + two sons 2 + their wives 2 + two grandsons 2 = 8.
recs.rel: Tip: do not forget to count the man himself in family-count questions.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q20) HIGH is to LOW as COWARD is to:
recs.facts: High and low are opposites; the opposite of coward is brave.
recs.rel: Tip: the opposite of coward is brave, whereas strong is a different quality.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q21) Which letter comes next in the following series: A, G, H, N, O, ?
recs.facts: The gaps alternate +6, +1: A to G is 6, G to H is 1, H to N is 6, N to O is 1, so O + 6 = U.
recs.rel: Tip: alternating large and small gaps usually mean two linked patterns.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q22) A man bought some chairs for Rs.3500 and sold them for Rs.5500. He earned a profit of Rs.100 per chair. How many chairs did he buy?
recs.facts: Total profit = 5500 - 3500 = 2000. At Rs.100 per chair, the number of chairs = 2000 / 100 = 20.
recs.rel: Tip: total profit divided by profit per item gives the number of items.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q23) PERMANENT is the opposite of:
recs.facts: Permanent means lasting for ever; its opposite is temporary.
recs.rel: Tip: changing is similar in idea but temporary is the true antonym.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q24) Which number comes next: 130, 81, 45, 20, ?
recs.facts: Differences are 49, 36, 25, which are 7 squared, 6 squared and 5 squared. Next is 4 squared = 16: 20 - 16 = 4.
recs.rel: Tip: differences that look like perfect squares (49, 36, 25, 16) are a clue.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q25) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Pear, orange, banana and apple are fruits, while potato is a vegetable.
recs.rel: Tip: classify by food group when a list mixes fruits and vegetables.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q26) NEVER means the opposite of:
recs.facts: The opposite of never is always.
recs.rel: Tip: seldom is only close to never, but always is the exact opposite.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q27) Which number comes next: 19, 10, 15, 7, 11, 4, ?
recs.facts: Take alternate terms: 19, 15, 11 fall by 4, so the next is 7 (the other series 10, 7, 4 falls by 3).
recs.rel: Tip: for zigzag series, separate odd and even positions and find the next term of the right series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q28) SKY is HIGH as EARTH is:
recs.facts: The sky is high and the earth is low by comparison.
recs.rel: Tip: in this analogy the second word describes the position of the first.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q29) A man bought 2 dozen eggs at the rate of Rs.10 per dozen and 36 eggs at the rate of Rs.12 per dozen. How many rupees did he pay in all?
recs.facts: Two dozen at Rs.10 cost Rs.20. 36 eggs are 3 dozen at Rs.12, costing Rs.36. Total = 20 + 36 = Rs.56.
recs.rel: Tip: convert everything to dozens before multiplying by the rate.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 8 · Q30) A person who flies an AIRCRAFT is called:
recs.facts: A person who flies an aircraft is a pilot.
recs.rel: Tip: captain is a rank, while pilot is the name of the job.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q1) Which letter comes next in the following series: B, E, G, J, L, ?
recs.facts: The gaps alternate +3, +2: B to E is 3, E to G is 2, G to J is 3, J to L is 2, so L + 3 = O.
recs.rel: Tip: alternating gaps of 3 and 2 repeat; add the next gap in turn.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q2) Which number comes next: 34, 24, 16, 10, 6, ?
recs.facts: Differences are -10, -8, -6, -4, so the next is -2: 6 - 2 = 4.
recs.rel: Tip: differences that shrink by 2 each step form a second-order series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q3) If you can buy 4 pencils for Rs.6, how many can you buy for Rs.18?
recs.facts: Rs.18 is three times Rs.6, so you get 3 x 4 = 12 pencils.
recs.rel: Tip: use ratios, because tripling the money triples the quantity.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q4) DERANGE is to 4371563 as GRAND is to:
recs.rel: Tip: build the letter-digit table first, then translate the new word.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q5) DANGEROUS means the opposite of:
recs.facts: The opposite of dangerous is safe.
recs.rel: Tip: threatening is a synonym, not an antonym.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q6) DARK is to NIGHT as DAY is to:
recs.facts: Darkness is associated with night, and light is associated with day.
recs.rel: Tip: this is a characteristic-of analogy.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q7) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: House, hut and villa are specific types of homes to live in, while building is a general term for any structure.
recs.rel: Tip: spot the word that is a general category rather than a specific kind.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q8) Which letter comes next in the following series: C, F, H, K, M, ?
recs.facts: The gaps alternate +3, +2: C to F is 3, F to H is 2, H to K is 3, K to M is 2, so M + 3 = P.
recs.rel: Tip: write each letter as a number and list the gaps.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q9) Which number comes next: 30, 27, 24, 21, ?
recs.facts: Each number falls by 3, so 21 - 3 = 18.
recs.rel: Tip: a constant difference means an arithmetic series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q10) If pencils sell at Rs.10 per dozen and the price of one sharpener is Rs.2, what will be the price of 24 pencils and one dozen sharpeners?
recs.facts: 24 pencils are 2 dozen = Rs.20. One dozen sharpeners = 12 x 2 = Rs.24. Total = Rs.44.
recs.rel: Tip: convert to the unit used in the price (dozens) before multiplying.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q11) If March comes before April and April comes after July, write 6 as your answer, otherwise write the last letter of the month that comes at the end of the year.
recs.facts: April does not come after July, so the condition is false. The month at the end of the year is December, whose last letter is R.
recs.rel: Tip: check the condition first; both parts must be true for the first answer.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q12) If Anwar is a student and all students are lazy then he:
recs.facts: All students are lazy and Anwar is a student, so Anwar is lazy.
recs.rel: Tip: a universal statement (all) applies to every member of the group.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q13) Which letter comes next: Z, W, T, Q, N, ?
recs.facts: Each letter moves back by 3: Z, W, T, Q, N, then N - 3 = K.
recs.rel: Tip: count back three places in the alphabet each time. (This question is handwritten on the paper as number 13.)

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q14) How many letters of the word CENTRAL are also found in the word DISCOVER?
recs.facts: DISCOVER contains C, E and R from CENTRAL; N, T, A and L are missing. So the answer is 3.
recs.rel: Tip: check each letter of the first word against the second, one by one.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q15) Twelve years ago Akhtar was half of his present age. What will be his age after 12 years?
recs.facts: If x is his age, x - 12 = x / 2, so x = 24. After 12 years he will be 24 + 12 = 36.
recs.rel: Tip: set up a simple equation instead of guessing ages.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q16) RED is to BLOOD as WHITE is to:
recs.facts: Blood is red and milk is white, so the pairing is an object and its colour.
recs.rel: Tip: this is a colour-association analogy.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q17) MAN is to MASCULINE as WOMAN is to:
recs.facts: Masculine is the adjective for a man and feminine is the adjective for a woman.
recs.rel: Tip: match the type of word, here an adjective.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q18) Which letter comes next in the following series: D, F, I, M, R, ?
recs.facts: The gaps increase by 1 each time: +2, +3, +4, +5, and the next is +6: R + 6 = X.
recs.rel: Tip: gaps that grow by one each step are a common letter pattern.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q19) A family consists of a man, his two wives, three daughters, four sons and their wives. How many members are there in the whole family?
recs.facts: Man 1 + two wives 2 + three daughters 3 + four sons 4 + sons' wives 4 = 14.
recs.rel: Tip: list each group and add; include the man himself.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q20) FAST means the opposite of:
recs.facts: The opposite of fast is slow.
recs.rel: Tip: quick and speed are synonyms, so they cannot be the answer.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q21) Which letter comes next in the following series: A, B, I, J, Q, ?
recs.facts: The gaps alternate +1, +7: A to B is 1, B to I is 7, I to J is 1, J to Q is 7, so Q + 1 = R.
recs.rel: Tip: pairs of consecutive letters separated by a big gap are a classic pattern.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q22) If three is subtracted from 12, then what will be one third of the remaining?
recs.facts: 12 - 3 = 9, and one third of 9 is 3.
recs.rel: Tip: follow the order of operations given in the sentence.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q23) BOTTLE is to CORK as BOX is to:
recs.facts: A cork closes a bottle, and a lid closes a box.
recs.rel: Tip: this is an object and its closing part.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q24) Which number comes next: 11, 6, 7, 3, 5, ?
recs.facts: The changes follow a pattern: -5, +1, -4, +2, -3. So 5 - 3 = 2.
recs.rel: Tip: when the differences alternate in sign, look at the sequence of subtracted and added amounts separately.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q25) Which group of letters is different from the others?
recs.facts: ACBC, XZYZ and JLK(L) follow the same pattern of one letter, one ahead, one in between, repeating the middle one; MCPO does not follow it.
recs.rel: Tip: compare the position patterns inside each group, not the letters themselves.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q26) FOOT is to LEG as HAND is to:
recs.facts: The foot is attached to the leg, and the hand is attached to the arm.
recs.rel: Tip: this is a body-part connection analogy.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q27) Which number comes next: 18, 13, 9, 6, 4, ?
recs.facts: The differences are -5, -4, -3, -2, so the next is -1: 4 - 1 = 3.
recs.rel: Tip: the differences decrease by one each time.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q28) INFANCY is to CHILDHOOD as ADOLESCENCE is to:
recs.facts: Stages of life follow in order: infancy, childhood, adolescence, then youth.
recs.rel: Tip: the sequence of human life stages is infancy, childhood, adolescence, adulthood, old age.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q29) What number when multiplied by 3 gives one less than 10?
recs.facts: One less than 10 is 9, and 9 / 3 = 3.
recs.rel: Tip: work backwards by dividing the result by the multiplier.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 9 · Q30) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Sing, call and speak are all ways of making sounds with the voice, while hear is a way of receiving sounds.
recs.rel: Tip: separate actions of producing from actions of receiving.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q1) Which letter comes next in the following series: D, G, K, N, R, ?
recs.facts: The gaps alternate +3, +4: D to G is 3, G to K is 4, K to N is 3, N to R is 4, so R + 3 = U.
recs.rel: Tip: alternating gaps of 3 and 4 repeat in turn.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q2) Which number comes next: 81, 64, 49, 36, ?
recs.facts: These are perfect squares in descending order: 9 squared, 8 squared, 7 squared, 6 squared, and next is 5 squared = 25.
recs.rel: Tip: learn the squares up to 20 to spot these series quickly.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q3) If apples are sold for Rs.15 per kg, how many grams can you buy for Rs.6?
recs.facts: Rs.6 / Rs.15 = 0.4 kg, which is 400 grams.
recs.rel: Tip: 1 kg equals 1000 grams, so convert at the end.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q4) TRIP is to DAY as CALENDAR is to:
recs.facts: A trip is measured in days, and a calendar is measured in a year.
recs.rel: Tip: this is a unit-of-measure analogy; match the unit that the object covers.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q5) CLOCK is to DAY as CALENDAR is to:
recs.facts: A clock tracks the hours of a day, and a calendar tracks the days of a year.
recs.rel: Tip: a clock tracks the day, a calendar tracks the year.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q6) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Smuggle, cheat, steal and bribe are illegal or dishonest acts, while selling is a normal lawful activity.
recs.rel: Tip: look for the lawful item among a list of crimes.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q7) A person who writes poems is called:
recs.facts: A poet writes poems.
recs.rel: Tip: Allama Iqbal, the national poet of Pakistan, is a famous example.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q8) Which letter comes next in the following series: C, D, G, J, K, ?
recs.facts: The gaps are +1, +3, +3, +1, then +3: K + 3 = N.
recs.rel: Tip: when no single gap repeats, list all the gaps and look for the cycle.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q9) Which number comes next: 14, 10, 7, 5, ?
recs.facts: Differences are -4, -3, -2, so the next is -1: 5 - 1 = 4.
recs.rel: Tip: differences falling by one each step lead to a simple next difference.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q10) What will be the third angle of a triangle whose two angles are 45 degrees and 60 degrees?
recs.facts: The angles of a triangle add to 180 degrees: 180 - 45 - 60 = 75 degrees.
recs.rel: Tip: the angles in any triangle always add up to 180 degrees.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q11) If day before yesterday was FRIDAY, tomorrow would be:
recs.facts: If the day before yesterday was Friday, yesterday was Saturday and today is Sunday, so tomorrow is Monday.
recs.rel: Tip: count forward from the known day one step at a time.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q12) People buy food because:
recs.facts: Food is a basic need of the body, so people buy it because they need to eat it, whether or not they feel hungry at the moment.
recs.rel: Tip: when options overlap, the key answer is the most general and necessary reason.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q13) Which letter comes next in the following series: B, E, F, J, K, ?
recs.facts: The gaps are +3, +1, +4, +1, +5, so the next gap pattern gives K + 5 = P.
recs.rel: Tip: letter gaps that interleave +1 with growing gaps (3, 4, 5) are a common pattern.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q14) Clouds are formed because:
opts: Chemical changes take place in the atmosphere
recs.facts: Water from the seas, rivers and land evaporates, rises, cools and condenses into tiny droplets that make clouds.
recs.rel: Tip: this process is part of the water cycle: evaporation, condensation, precipitation.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q15) If mangoes sell at Rs.12 per kg, how much can be bought for Rs.768?
recs.rel: Tip: quantity equals total money divided by the price per unit.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q16) TRIANGLE is to PRISM as CIRCLE is to:
recs.facts: A prism is a triangle extended into three dimensions with the same cross-section, and a cylinder is a circle extended the same way.
recs.rel: Tip: the key sheet gives sphere here, but a prism has constant triangular cross-sections just as a cylinder has circular ones.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q17) RECEDE is to PROCEED as STOP is to:
recs.facts: Recede and proceed are opposites, and the opposite of stop is go.
recs.rel: Tip: recede means to move back, and proceed means to move forward.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q18) Which letter comes next in the following series: A, W, B, V, C, ?
recs.facts: Two series run together: A, B, C going forward and W, V, then U going backward.
recs.rel: Tip: interleaved series run in turn, one forward and one backward.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q19) If one dozen pencils can be bought for Rs.15, how much will 72 pencils cost?
recs.facts: 72 pencils are 6 dozen, so the cost is 6 x 15 = Rs.90.
recs.rel: Tip: convert the total number to dozens first.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q20) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Ankle, knee, foot and toe are all parts of the leg, while the tongue is in the mouth.
recs.rel: Tip: group body parts by the area they belong to.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q21) Which letter comes next in the following series: B, E, H, K, N, ?
recs.facts: Each letter moves forward by 3: N + 3 = Q.
recs.rel: Tip: a constant gap makes this one of the easiest letter series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q22) Which figure represents the smallest amount?
recs.facts: Comparing decimals: 0.09 is less than 0.9, 1.1, 3.1 and 10, so it is the smallest.
recs.rel: Tip: a decimal with more leading zeros after the point is smaller.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q23) EXTRAVAGANT means the opposite:
recs.facts: Extravagant means spending too much, and its opposite is economical, spending carefully.
recs.rel: Tip: the key sheet gives miser, but economical is the matching adjective, and wasteful is a synonym of extravagant.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q24) Which number comes next: 48, 24, 12, 6, ?
recs.facts: Each number is half of the previous one, so 6 / 2 = 3.
recs.rel: Tip: halving each time makes a geometric series with ratio one half.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q25) A bird does not always have:
recs.facts: Every bird has wings, eyes, feet and a bill, but not every bird builds or lives in a nest all the time.
recs.rel: Tip: the key sheet gives a bill, but a bill (beak) is a defining feature of all birds, so a nest is the best answer.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q26) BEGIN is to END as NORTH is to:
recs.facts: Begin and end are opposites, and the opposite direction of north is south.
recs.rel: Tip: the four cardinal directions form two opposite pairs: north and south, east and west.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q27) Which number comes next: 42, 30, 20, 12, ?
recs.facts: Differences are -12, -10, -8, so the next is -6: 12 - 6 = 6.
recs.rel: Tip: these numbers are products of consecutive integers (7x6, 6x5, 5x4, 4x3, 3x2).

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q28) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: Stem, root, branch and leaf are parts of a plant, while the tree is the whole plant.
recs.rel: Tip: look for the whole among a list of parts.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q29) Which number is missing in the following series: 98, 70, ?, 14
recs.facts: The series falls by 28 each time: 98, 70, 42, 14.
recs.rel: Tip: find the common difference from the two known neighbours (98 - 70 = 28).

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 10 · Q30) BAIT is to FISH as GUN is to:
recs.facts: Bait is the thing used to catch a fish, and a bullet is the thing fired from a gun to hit a target.
recs.rel: Tip: this analogy links a tool to what it is used to capture.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q1) Which letter comes next in the following series: A, B, F, G, K, ?
recs.facts: Positions in the alphabet are 1, 2, 6, 7, 11, so the steps alternate +1, +4, +1, +4, +1. Next is 11 + 1 = 12, which is L.
recs.rel: Tip: when letter gaps repeat in a cycle, write the letter positions as numbers and look at the differences.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q2) Which number comes next: 54321, 4321, 321, 21, ?
recs.facts: Each term drops the first digit of the one before: 54321, 4321, 321, 21, then 1.
recs.rel: Tip: if each term looks like a shortened copy of the previous one, the rule is removing a digit.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q3) CLOSE is to OPEN as NEAR is to:
recs.facts: CLOSE and OPEN are opposites, so the opposite of NEAR is FAR.
recs.rel: Tip: first name the relationship (opposite, synonym, part of) in the first pair, then apply it to the second.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q4) MEDICAL is to 5132768 as DECIMAL is to:
recs.facts: From MEDICAL = 5132768: M=5, E=1, D=3, I=2, C=7, A=6, L=8. DECIMAL is D3 E1 C7 I2 M5 A6 L8, which gives 3172568.
recs.rel: Tip: write the letter-to-digit code under the first word, then read off the second word letter by letter.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q5) If 12 is divided by 3, what will be the half of the remainder (taking the result of the division as intended by the paper)?
recs.facts: 12 divided by 3 gives 4, and half of 4 is 2 (this is the answer given in the paper key).
recs.rel: Tip: strictly, 12 divided by 3 leaves remainder 0, but such papers use the word remainder for the result of the division.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q6) HERE is to NOW as THERE is to:
recs.facts: HERE refers to place and NOW refers to time at the same point. THERE refers to a place, so its matching time word is THEN.
recs.rel: Tip: place and time words often pair up: here/now, there/then, where/when.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q7) TRANSPARENT is the opposite of:
recs.facts: TRANSPARENT means you can see through it clearly. The opposite, not clear to see through, is HAZY.
recs.rel: Tip: eliminate options that are synonyms first, as CLEAR is here.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q8) Which letter comes next: C, E, H, L, Q, ?
recs.facts: Positions are 3, 5, 8, 12, 17, so the differences are +2, +3, +4, +5. Next is +6: 17 + 6 = 23, which is W.
recs.rel: Tip: if differences grow by one each time, it is a second-order (quadratic) pattern.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q9) Which number comes next: 11, 6, 7, 3, 5, ?
recs.facts: Split into two series: 11, 7, 5 (differences -4, -2) and 6, 3, ? (the second series continues with differences -3, -1). So 6, 3, 2.
recs.rel: Tip: in alternating series, split the terms into two separate sequences.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q10) What number when subtracted from 21 will give 15 as the answer?
recs.rel: Tip: the missing number in a subtraction is the larger number minus the answer.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q11) Men wear shoes because they:
recs.facts: The real purpose of shoes is to protect the feet from injury, dirt and weather.
recs.rel: Tip: for common sense questions, choose the most basic and practical reason.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q12) Birds fly because:
recs.facts: Wings are the physical feature that makes flight possible. The other options are possible motives, not the cause.
recs.rel: Tip: not all birds fly; penguins and ostriches have wings but cannot fly.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q13) Which letter comes next: U, S, Q, O, M, ?
recs.facts: Each letter goes back two places in the alphabet: U, S, Q, O, M, then K.
recs.rel: Tip: a constant step backwards in the alphabet means counting down by the same number each time.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q14) Water becomes ice because:
opts: We want to have cold drinks
recs.facts: Water freezes into ice when the temperature falls to 0 degrees Celsius or below.
recs.rel: Tip: water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius (32 degrees Fahrenheit) at normal pressure.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q15) If the numbers 16, 2, 27, 9, 7 are arranged from the smallest to the largest, what will be the middle number?
recs.facts: Arranged in order: 2, 7, 9, 16, 27. The middle (third) number is 9.
recs.rel: Tip: with five numbers the middle one is the third after sorting.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q16) Who was the first king of Pakistan?
recs.facts: Pakistan has never had a king. Quaid-e-Azam was the first Governor-General, not a king.
recs.rel: Tip: Muhammad Ali Jinnah was Pakistan's first Governor-General, and Liaquat Ali Khan was its first Prime Minister.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q17) Which one of the following is different from the others?
recs.facts: OBVIOUS, CLEAR and APPARENT all mean easy to see or understand. DUBIOUS means doubtful.
recs.rel: Tip: in odd-one-out words, find the three that are synonyms and pick the remaining one.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q18) Which letter comes next: Y, S, N, J, G, ?
recs.facts: Positions are 25, 19, 14, 10, 7. The differences are -6, -5, -4, -3, so next is -2: 7 - 2 = 5, which is E.
recs.rel: Tip: shrinking differences (6, 5, 4, 3, 2) are common in letter series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q19) PIOUS means the same as:
recs.facts: PIOUS means deeply religious and devoted to worship.
recs.rel: Tip: a pious person is devout, while innocent means free from guilt.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q20) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: WRIST, KNEE and ELBOW are body joints. BALD is a condition, not a body part.
recs.rel: Tip: check whether three items belong to one category (here joints) and one does not.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q21) Which letter comes next: H, J, D, F, L, ?
recs.facts: Letter positions are 8, 10, 4, 6, 12, then 14. Within each pair the step is +2 (H to J, D to F, L to N), and the pairs themselves start at 8, 4, 12 (steps -4, +8), so the pair that begins with L ends with N.
recs.rel: Tip: if one step repeats (+2) between neighbours, the rest of the pattern is in how the pairs start.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q22) Twelve years ago Afzal weighed 50 kg. Every year he gained 2 kg. What is his weight now?
recs.facts: In 12 years he gained 12 x 2 = 24 kg, so his weight now is 50 + 24 = 74 kg.
recs.rel: Tip: multiply the yearly change by the number of years before adding to the starting value.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q23) DINNER is to NIGHT as MORNING is to:
recs.facts: Dinner is the meal eaten at night, and breakfast is the meal eaten in the morning.
recs.rel: Tip: the pair is meal and time of day.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q24) Which number comes next: 100, 64, 36, 16, ?
recs.facts: The terms are squares of even numbers going down: 10 squared, 8 squared, 6 squared, 4 squared, so next is 2 squared = 4.
recs.rel: Tip: learn the squares up to 20 to spot such series quickly.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q25) SCARCE means the same as:
recs.facts: SCARCE means in short supply, which is the same as RARE.
recs.rel: Tip: scarce and rare both describe something hard to find.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q26) DELICATE is the opposite of:
recs.facts: DELICATE means fragile or easily broken, so its opposite is STRONG.
recs.rel: Tip: choose the opposite of the main meaning (fragile versus strong), not the opposite of a side meaning.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q27) Which number comes next: 256, 64, 16, 4, ?
recs.facts: Each term is divided by 4: 256, 64, 16, 4, then 4 / 4 = 1.
recs.rel: Tip: check ratios as well as differences when terms shrink fast.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q28) The speed of sound is faster than the speed of light:
recs.facts: Light travels at about 300,000 km per second, while sound in air travels at only about 343 metres per second.
recs.rel: Tip: this is why you see lightning before you hear thunder.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q29) A man earned Rs. 28 and saved Rs. 7. What percent of his earning did he save?
recs.facts: Percent saved = 7 / 28 x 100 = 25%.
recs.rel: Tip: percent = part divided by whole, times 100.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 11 · Q30) MILE is to LAND as KNOT is to:
recs.facts: A mile is a unit of distance used on land, and a knot is a unit of speed used at sea.
recs.rel: Tip: one nautical mile equals 1.852 km, and a knot is one nautical mile per hour.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q1) Which letter comes next: C, E, H, L, ?
recs.facts: Positions are 3, 5, 8, 12 with differences +2, +3, +4. Next is +5: 12 + 5 = 17, which is Q.
recs.rel: Tip: when the gap increases by one each time, add the next larger gap.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q2) Which number comes next: 35, 19, 11, 7, ?
recs.facts: Differences are -16, -8, -4, so the next is -2: 7 - 2 = 5.
recs.rel: Tip: halving differences point to a pattern of repeated division by 2.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q3) The average cost of bananas, oranges and apples is Rs. 30 per kg. If bananas cost Rs. 10 per kg and oranges cost Rs. 45 per kg, how much do apples cost per kg?
recs.facts: Total of the three prices = 3 x 30 = 90. Apples = 90 - 10 - 45 = Rs. 35 per kg.
recs.rel: Tip: average times the number of items gives the total.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q4) TRAVEL is to 45936 as LATER is to (code: T=4, R=5, A=9, E=3, L=6 as in the printed number):
recs.facts: From the code T=4, R=5, A=9, E=3, L=6. LATER is L6 A9 T4 E3 R5, which gives 69435.
recs.rel: Tip: the printed code has five digits for the letters T, R, A, E, L, so match each digit to its letter in order.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q5) LATE means the opposite of:
recs.facts: The question asks for the opposite of LATE, which is EARLY.
recs.rel: Tip: read the question stem carefully; here it asks for the opposite, not a synonym.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q6) FISH is to SWIM as BIRD is to:
recs.facts: A fish moves by swimming, and a bird moves by flying.
recs.rel: Tip: this is an animal and its mode of movement.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q7) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: TALL, LARGE, HIGH and BIG all express greater size. SMALL is the opposite.
recs.rel: Tip: look for the antonym among a group of synonyms.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q8) Which letter comes next: A, D, I, P, ?
recs.facts: Positions are 1, 4, 9, 16, which are the squares 1, 2, 3, 4 squared. Next is 5 squared = 25, which is Y.
recs.rel: Tip: positions of 1, 4, 9, 16, 25 are perfect squares.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q9) Which number comes next: 1440, 240, 48, 12, ?
recs.rel: Tip: dividers that fall by one each time (6, 5, 4, 3) are a factorial-style pattern.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q10) A train travels 6 meters in 1/4 minutes. How much distance (in meters) does it travel in 5 minutes?
recs.facts: 5 minutes contain 20 quarter-minutes, so the distance is 20 x 6 = 120 meters.
recs.rel: Tip: convert the time into units of the given interval and then multiply.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q11) Copper is cheaper than gold because it is:
recs.facts: Price depends on supply and demand, and copper is much more abundant than gold.
recs.rel: Tip: scarcity is the main reason precious metals cost more.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q12) People go to a doctor because:
opts: They want to see sick people
It is pleasant in the clinic
recs.facts: The purpose of visiting a doctor is to get treatment for an illness.
recs.rel: Tip: choose the answer that states the real purpose.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q13) Which letter comes next: R, M, I, F, ?
recs.facts: Positions are 18, 13, 9, 6 with differences -5, -4, -3. Next is -2: 6 - 2 = 4, which is D.
recs.rel: Tip: write letters as numbers; the differences shrink by one each time.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q14) We go to the cinema because:
opts: Cinema halls are good to look at
recs.facts: The direct purpose of going to the cinema is to see films.
recs.rel: Tip: the best answer states the main purpose, not a side reason.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q15) If a pencil costs Rs. 10 per dozen and one sharpener costs Rs. 3, what will be the cost of 24 pencils and one dozen sharpeners?
recs.facts: 24 pencils are 2 dozen = 2 x 10 = Rs. 20. A dozen sharpeners cost 12 x 3 = Rs. 36. Total = 20 + 36 = Rs. 56.
recs.rel: Tip: convert everything to the same unit (dozens or single items) before adding.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q16) HIGH is to LOW as BAD is to:
recs.facts: HIGH and LOW are opposites, and the opposite of BAD is GOOD.
recs.rel: Tip: EVIL is a synonym of BAD, not the opposite.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q17) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: WEAK, UGLY, SLOW and DULL are all negative qualities. BRIGHT is a positive one.
recs.rel: Tip: sort the options by positive and negative meaning.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q18) Which letter comes next: B, D, G, L, ?
recs.facts: Positions are 2, 4, 7, 12 with differences 2, 3, 5, and each difference is one more than a power of 2 (2^0+1, 2^1+1 and so on: 2, 3, 5, 9). Next difference is 9: 12 + 9 = 21, which is U. Another reading of the gaps (2, 3, 5, 8) would give T, but the paper's answer key is U.
recs.rel: Tip: if differences are not simple, subtract a constant from them and look for powers of 2.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q19) A man earns Rs. 20 for producing 40 units of work. For each unit produced over 40 he is paid at 1 1/2 times his regular rate. How much will he receive if he produces 52 units of work?
recs.facts: Regular rate is 20 / 40 = Rs. 0.50 per unit, so the overtime rate is Rs. 0.75. For 12 extra units he gets 12 x 0.75 = Rs. 9, so the total is 20 + 9 = Rs. 29.
recs.rel: Tip: find the regular unit rate first, then apply the multiplier to the extra units only.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q20) CLOCK is to TIME as THERMOMETER is to:
recs.facts: A clock is an instrument that measures time, and a thermometer measures temperature.
recs.rel: Tip: the pattern is instrument and the quantity it measures.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q21) Which letter comes next: A, C, F, H, ?
recs.facts: Positions are 1, 3, 6, 8 with alternating steps +2, +3, +2. Next is +3: 8 + 3 = 11, which is K.
recs.rel: Tip: alternating steps repeat in a fixed cycle.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q22) A man earns Rs. 2400 per month. He pays Rs. 1500 for office rent and Rs. 200 is spent as office expense. How much tax does he pay if the balance is taxed at the rate of 5%?
recs.rel: Tip: tax applies only to the balance left after the deductions named in the question.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q24) Which number comes next: 11, 12, 10, 13, 9, ?
recs.facts: Alternate terms form two series: 11, 10, 9 (going down by 1) and 12, 13, 14 (going up by 1). The next term is in the second series: 14.
recs.rel: Tip: in alternating series, split the terms into two separate sequences.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q25) EYE is to SEE as NOSE is to:
recs.facts: The eye is the organ used to see, and the nose is the organ used to smell.
recs.rel: Tip: the pattern is organ and its function.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q26) BACKWARDS means the same as:
recs.facts: BACKWARDS means in the reverse direction, so REVERSED is the closest match.
recs.rel: Tip: FORWARDS is the opposite, not a synonym.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q27) Which number comes next: 99, 80, 63, 48, ?
recs.facts: Differences are -19, -17, -15, so next is -13: 48 - 13 = 35.
recs.rel: Tip: differences that fall by 2 each time form a second-order series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q28) WHEN is to TIME as WHERE is to:
recs.facts: WHEN asks about time and WHERE asks about place, which is SPACE.
recs.rel: Tip: question words map to concepts: when is time, where is place or space.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q29) If Azam can ride a bicycle 300 feet while Akram runs 200 feet, how many feet can Azam ride while Akram runs 300 feet?
recs.facts: Azam covers 1.5 feet for every foot Akram runs (300 / 200). When Akram runs 300 feet, Azam rides 300 x 1.5 = 450 feet.
recs.rel: Tip: find the ratio of the two distances and scale it.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 12 · Q30) MULTIPLICATION is the opposite of:
recs.facts: Multiplication and division are inverse operations, so DIVISION is the opposite.
recs.rel: Tip: addition and subtraction are also inverse operations of each other.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q1) Which comes next in the following series: E, GH, JKL, NOP?, with each block one letter longer and one letter skipped between blocks (the last block is NOPQ)? What is the last letter of the fourth block?
recs.facts: The blocks are E (1 letter), GH (2), JKL (3), NOPQ (4), with one letter skipped between blocks (F, I, M). The completing letter of the fourth block is Q.
recs.rel: Tip: in block series, count how long each block is and which letters are skipped.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q2) Which number comes next: 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, ?
recs.facts: The steps alternate +1, +2, +1, +2, so after 7 comes 7 + 1 = 8.
recs.rel: Tip: repeating step cycles like +1, +2 are common.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q3) If a boy can run 2 feet in 1/10 seconds, how many feet can he run in 10 seconds?
recs.facts: In 10 seconds there are 100 intervals of 1/10 seconds, so the distance is 100 x 2 = 200 feet.
recs.rel: Tip: divide the total time by the small interval to find how many intervals fit.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q4) HAPPINESS is to 415537299 as SHAPE is to:
recs.facts: From HAPPINESS = 415537299: H=4, A=1, P=5, I=3, N=7, E=2, S=9. SHAPE is S9 H4 A1 P5 E2, which is 94152.
recs.rel: Tip: build the letter table from the long word first.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q5) BIG means the opposite of:
recs.facts: The opposite of BIG is SMALL.
recs.rel: Tip: LARGE is a synonym of BIG, so it is a trap.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q6) SEEING is to PICTURE as HEARING is to:
recs.facts: We see a picture and we hear a song, so the object of hearing is a SONG.
recs.rel: Tip: the pattern is sense and the object it perceives.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q7) FLAT means the same as:
recs.facts: A flat surface is a level surface, with no slope.
recs.rel: Tip: INCLINED, UNEVEN and OBLIQUE all describe slopes or bumps, so they are opposites.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q8) Which letter comes next: KLMNO, LMNO, MNO, NO, ?
recs.facts: Each term drops the first letter of the one before: KLMNO, LMNO, MNO, NO, then O.
recs.rel: Tip: if each term is shorter by one letter, the rule is removing the first letter.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q9) Which number comes next: 15, 35, 55, 75, 95, ?
recs.facts: Each term goes up by 20, so 95 + 20 = 115.
recs.rel: Tip: constant differences make an arithmetic series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q10) Add all the numbers in the following series and divide the total by the highest number: 2, 5, 4, 8, 7, 6
recs.facts: The total is 2 + 5 + 4 + 8 + 7 + 6 = 32. The highest number is 8, and 32 / 8 = 4.
recs.rel: Tip: add carefully in pairs to avoid slips.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q11) If yesterday was WEDNESDAY, tomorrow would be:
recs.facts: If yesterday was Wednesday then today is Thursday, so tomorrow is Friday.
recs.rel: Tip: tomorrow is always two days after yesterday.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q12) The Sun rises in the East because:
opts: The Moon revolves around the Sun
The Earth rotates from West to East
It always comes up on that side
The Earth revolves around the Sun
recs.facts: The Earth spins from West to East, so the Sun appears to rise in the East.
recs.rel: Tip: day and night are caused by rotation, and the seasons are caused by revolution.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q13) Which letter comes next: E, G, J, N, ?
recs.facts: Positions are 5, 7, 10, 14 with differences +2, +3, +4. Next is +5: 14 + 5 = 19, which is S.
recs.rel: Tip: if the gaps grow by one each time, keep adding the next bigger gap.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q14) Games are played:
opts: They help us in keeping good health
We like to compete with others
There is nothing else to do
recs.facts: The most important reason is that games keep us physically fit and healthy.
recs.rel: Tip: choose the most meaningful reason among the options.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q15) If the numbers 12, 2, 27, 11, 7 are arranged from the smallest to the largest, what will be the middle number?
recs.facts: Arranged in order: 2, 7, 11, 12, 27. The middle number is 11.
recs.rel: Tip: sort first, then take the third of five.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q16) GIFT means the same as:
recs.facts: A gift is also called a present.
recs.rel: Tip: PRESENT is also a word for the current time, so watch for context.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q17) IRON is to HEAVY as FEATHER is to:
recs.facts: Iron is a heavy material, and a feather is light.
recs.rel: Tip: this analogy links an object to its typical quality.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q19) What will be the third angle of a triangle whose two angles are 30 degrees and 80 degrees?
recs.facts: The angles of a triangle add to 180 degrees, so the third angle is 180 - 30 - 80 = 70 degrees.
recs.rel: Tip: the three interior angles of any triangle always sum to 180 degrees.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q20) YOUNG means the same as:
recs.facts: YOUNG and YOUTHFUL both mean in the early part of life.
recs.rel: Tip: BABY names a person, it is not an adjective like YOUNG.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q21) Which letter comes next: B, D, G, L, ?
recs.facts: Positions are 2, 4, 7, 12 with differences 2, 3, 5. Each difference is one more than a power of 2 (2, 3, 5, 9), so next is +9: 12 + 9 = 21, which is U. Another reading of the gaps (2, 3, 5, 8) would give T, but the paper's answer key is U.
recs.rel: Tip: if differences are not simple, subtract a constant from them and look for powers of 2.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q22) In a school out of 200 teachers, 45% are more than 50 years old and 65% are married. Are there any who are unmarried and below 50 years?
recs.facts: 90 teachers are over 50 and 130 are married. These groups overlap by at least 20, but it is possible that all 70 unmarried teachers are over 50, and equally possible that some are below 50. So we cannot say for sure.
recs.rel: Tip: when data gives only percentages of overlapping groups, the minimum overlap does not fix the unknown group, so CANNOT SAY is common.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q23) INDUSTRIOUS means the same as:
recs.facts: INDUSTRIOUS describes someone who works diligently, which is HARD-WORKING.
recs.rel: Tip: industrious comes from the Latin industria meaning diligence, and should not be confused with industrial.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q24) Which number comes next: 2, 8, 26, 80, ?
recs.facts: Each term is 3 times the previous term plus 2: 2, 8, 26, 80, then 80 x 3 + 2 = 242.
recs.rel: Tip: if terms grow by about 3 times each step, test the rule multiply by 3 then add a constant.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q25) WHEEL is to BICYCLE as LEG is to:
recs.facts: A wheel is a part of a bicycle, and a leg is a part of the body.
recs.rel: Tip: LEG is also a part of a TABLE, so use the body-part sense for the closest match here.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q26) Which one of the following is different from the rest?
recs.facts: TRIANGLE, PARALLELOGRAM, SQUARE and RECTANGLE are made of straight sides and corners. A CIRCLE has a curved boundary and no corners.
recs.rel: Tip: a circle is the only common shape with no straight sides.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q27) Which number comes next: 130, 118, 107, 97, 88, ?
recs.facts: Differences are -12, -11, -10, -9, so next is -8: 88 - 8 = 80.
recs.rel: Tip: differences decreasing by one each step give a simple second-order pattern.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q28) DOUBT means the opposite of:
recs.facts: DOUBT means uncertainty, and the opposite is certainty, closest to CERTAINLY.
recs.rel: Tip: DUBIOUS is a synonym of doubtful, so it is a trap.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q29) If a 20 feet long wire is to be cut so that one piece is 2/3 as long as the other piece, how long will be the shorter piece?
recs.facts: The pieces are in the ratio 2:3, so there are 5 parts in total, and each part is 20 / 5 = 4 feet. The shorter piece is 2 x 4 = 8 feet.
recs.rel: Tip: turn a ratio of 2 to 3 into 5 equal parts of the total.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 13 · Q30) CLEAR is to DIM as NEAT is to:
recs.facts: CLEAR and DIM are opposites, so we need the opposite of NEAT, which is DIRTY.
recs.rel: Tip: when a pair is opposites, pick the antonym and reject synonyms like TIDY.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q2) Which one is different from the rest?
recs.facts: AC, CE, EG and GI each skip one letter and the second letter of each pair becomes the first letter of the next. II repeats the same letter, so it is different.
recs.rel: Tip: in letter pairs, compare how the second letter relates to the first.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q3) What will come next in the following series: E0 V, E1 W, E2 X, E3 Y, ?
recs.facts: The subscript goes up by 1 each time (0, 1, 2, 3, then 4) and the letter moves along V, W, X, Y, then Z.
recs.rel: Tip: when a term has two parts, find the rule for each part separately.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q4) What will come next in the following series: 47, 40, 34, 29, 25, ?
recs.facts: Differences are -7, -6, -5, -4, so next is -3: 25 - 3 = 22.
recs.rel: Tip: if the gap reduces by one each time, continue the reducing gap.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q6) What will come next in the following series: 2, 3, 8, 63, ?
recs.facts: Each term is the square of the previous term minus 1: 2 squared minus 1 = 3, 3 squared minus 1 = 8, 8 squared minus 1 = 63, and 63 squared minus 1 = 3969 - 1 = 3968.
recs.rel: Tip: fast growth in a series often means a squaring rule.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q7) Which letter comes first alphabetically among the letters of the word MOTHER?
recs.facts: The letters of MOTHER in alphabetical order are E, H, M, O, R, T, so the first is E.
recs.rel: Tip: write out the letters in alphabetical order to find the first or last.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q8) If FACE is coded as 6135, then ACE is coded as:
recs.facts: From FACE = 6135, F=6, A=1, C=3, E=5. So ACE is 1, 3, 5, which gives 135.
recs.rel: Tip: the printed word options for this question do not fit, since the answer is a number code.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q9) Which one is different from the rest?
recs.facts: YARD, FOOT and KILOMETER are units of length. LENGTH is the quantity being measured, not a unit.
recs.rel: Tip: separate the units from the quantity they measure.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q10) HEAR is to EAR as CLOSE is to:
recs.facts: Removing the first letter of HEAR gives EAR, and removing the first letter of CLOSE gives LOSE.
recs.rel: Tip: check for hidden words made by dropping a letter.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q11) SOW is to SEED as REAP is to:
recs.facts: We sow seed, and we reap the crop.
recs.rel: Tip: GRAIN is only one kind of crop, so CROP is the best match for the pair.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q12) TIGHT is to LOOSE as HARD is to:
recs.facts: TIGHT and LOOSE are opposites, and the opposite of HARD is SOFT.
recs.rel: Tip: DIFFICULT is another meaning of HARD, so it is a synonym, not an opposite.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q13) Which word does not belong to the list?
recs.facts: BLACKSMITH, TAILOR and MASON are skilled manual craftsmen. A PROFESSOR is an academic.
recs.rel: Tip: split professions into manual trades and academic jobs.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q15) BIRD is to CAGE as PRISONER is to:
recs.facts: A bird is kept in a cage, and a prisoner is kept in a cell.
recs.rel: Tip: the pattern is captive and the place where it is kept.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q16) Which one is different from the rest? 24, 48, 510, 611, 1130
recs.facts: 24, 48, 510 and 1130 are all even numbers. 611 is the only odd number.
recs.rel: Tip: check even or odd and divisibility first when numbers are listed.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q18) What number comes next: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
recs.facts: Differences are +4, +6, +8, +10, so next is +12: 30 + 12 = 42.
recs.rel: Tip: these are products of consecutive numbers: 1x2, 2x3, 3x4, 4x5, 5x6, then 6x7 = 42.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q19) FINGER is to ELBOW as TOE is to:
recs.facts: The elbow is the joint in the middle of the arm, and the knee is the matching middle joint of the leg.
recs.rel: Tip: map the arm to the leg to find the matching joint.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q21) SINGLE is to DOUBLE as ONE is to:
recs.facts: SINGLE means one and DOUBLE means two, so the number matching ONE in the pair is TWO.
recs.rel: Tip: the pair moves from a count to the next count.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q22) Which one is different from the rest?
recs.facts: PLEADER, MAGISTRATE, JUDGE and ADVOCATE all work in the legal system. A COOK does not.
recs.rel: Tip: group the options by profession field.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q23) BOOK is to TITLE as MAN is to:
recs.facts: A book is identified by its title, and a man is identified by his name.
recs.rel: Tip: this pair links a thing to the label that identifies it.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q24) Which word is out of the list?
recs.facts: COW, GOAT, SHEEP and BUFFALO are cud-chewing animals that give milk for human use. A HORSE is not a ruminant.
recs.rel: Tip: ruminants have a four-part stomach and chew the cud.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q25) Write the next number in the series: 1, 4, 10, 22, 46, ?
recs.facts: Each term is double the previous term plus 2: 1, 4, 10, 22, 46, then 46 x 2 + 2 = 94.
recs.rel: Tip: if terms roughly double, test multiply by 2 and add a constant.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q26) Which word is out of the list?
recs.facts: SPEECH, SERMON, LECTURE and ORATION are formal addresses to an audience. GOSSIP is casual talk about other people.
recs.rel: Tip: separate formal speaking from casual speaking.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q27) A is to E as C is to:
recs.facts: A is the 1st letter and E is the 5th, so we move forward 4 places. C is the 3rd, and 3 + 4 = 7, which is G.
recs.rel: Tip: count the number of places between the first pair and repeat the same jump.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q28) Write the next two numbers: 5, 3, 6, 4, 7, 5, 8, 6, 9, ?, ?
recs.facts: Alternate terms form two series: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 (going up by 1) and 3, 4, 5, 6 (going up by 1). After 9 comes 7 from the second series, then 10 from the first.
recs.rel: Tip: in alternating series, split the terms into two separate sequences.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 14 · Q30) What number comes next: 3, 8, 14, 21, 29, 38, ?
recs.facts: Differences are +5, +6, +7, +8, +9, so next is +10: 38 + 10 = 48.
recs.rel: Tip: differences that grow by one each time make a second-order series.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 15 · Q1) Which one of the following is different? A. MNO, B. STW, C. XYZ, D. EFG, E. BCD
recs.facts: MNO, XYZ, EFG and BCD are three consecutive letters of the alphabet. STW skips a letter (S, T, then W).
recs.rel: Tip: in letter-group questions first check whether the letters are consecutive, then check gaps and direction.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 15 · Q2) Which one of the following is different? A. EVU, B. RHI, C. OLK, D. SHG, E. HSR
recs.facts: EVU, OLK, SHG and HSR all end with two letters in backward alphabetical order (V U, L K, H G, S R). RHI ends with H I, which goes forward.
recs.rel: Tip: compare the direction of movement inside each group, not only the letters themselves.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 15 · Q3) Which one of the following is different? A. PQO, B. KJL, C. UYW, D. SRT, E. FEG
recs.facts: KJL, SRT and FEG each go one step back then two steps forward (-1, +2). PQO goes forward then back (+1, -2), the reverse of that pattern, which is the answer given in the key.
recs.rel: Tip: write the step sizes between neighbouring letters, as in +1, -2, to spot the odd group.

recs.q: (Forces Academy Test 15 · Q4) Which one of the following is different? A. LLMN, B. UUVW, C. CCDE, D. GGHI, E. RRRS
recs.facts: The others repeat the first letter twice and then follow with the next two consecutive letters. RRRS repeats its first letter three times.
