recs.facts: Yesterday Friday means today is Saturday, so tomorrow is Sunday.
recs.rel: Yesterday, today and tomorrow are three consecutive days; tomorrow is 2 days after yesterday.

recs.q: If the 4th day of a month is Sunday, what day will the 14th day be?
recs.facts: The gap is 10 days and 10 mod 7 = 3, so the day moves 3 step(s) ahead of Sunday, which gives Wednesday. The source statement (14th is Monday) is wrong.
recs.rel: Days: shift by the remainder after dividing the gap between the two dates by 7 (gap 7, 14, 21 gives the same day).

recs.q: A car is moving at 120 km/h. How much distance does it cover in 10 minutes?
recs.facts: 10 minutes = 1/6 hour, and 120 x 1/6 = 20 km.
recs.rel: Km per minute = km/h divided by 60 (120 km/h = 2 km per minute).

recs.q: What is 120 x 7?
recs.rel: Multiply the non-zero part first, then add the zero back.

recs.q: If the 28th day of a month is Monday, what day will the 8th day be?
recs.facts: The 2nd date is 20 days earlier; 20 mod 7 = 6, so go back 6 day(s) from Monday (same as 1 ahead), which gives Tuesday.
recs.rel: Days: shift by the remainder after dividing the gap between the two dates by 7 (gap 7, 14, 21 gives the same day).

recs.q: A man walks 20 km in 1 hour and 40 minutes. How much time will he take to cover 1 km?
recs.facts: 100 minutes / 20 km = 5 minutes per km.
recs.rel: Time per km = total time divided by total km.

recs.q: Ahmad walks towards the north and then turns left. In which direction is he facing now?
recs.facts: Facing north, the left hand side is west.
recs.rel: Facing north: left is west, right is east. Facing south: left is east, right is west.

recs.q: If the 2nd day of a month is Friday, what day will the 23rd day be?
recs.facts: The gap is 21 days and 21 mod 7 = 0, so the day moves 0 step(s) ahead of Friday, which gives Friday.
recs.rel: Days: shift by the remainder after dividing the gap between the two dates by 7 (gap 7, 14, 21 gives the same day).

recs.q: Ali is 5 years old and his sister Sidra is twice his age. How old will Sidra be when Ali is 11 years old?
recs.facts: Sidra is 10 now, so she is 5 years older than Ali. When Ali is 11, Sidra is 11 + 5 = 16.
recs.rel: The age difference between two people never changes.

recs.q: If the 1st day of a month is Monday, what day will the 13th day be?
recs.facts: The gap is 12 days and 12 mod 7 = 5, so the day moves 5 step(s) ahead of Monday, which gives Saturday.
recs.rel: Days: shift by the remainder after dividing the gap between the two dates by 7 (gap 7, 14, 21 gives the same day).

recs.q: What is a quarter of 120?
recs.rel: A quarter is 25 percent, and half of a half.

recs.q: In a class of 500 students, 340 are boys. What percentage are boys?
recs.rel: Percentage = part/total x 100; out of 500, each student is 0.2 percent.

recs.q: If 1 dozen pencils cost Rs 60, what is the cost of 5 pencils?
recs.facts: 1 dozen = 12 pencils, so one pencil costs 60/12 = Rs 5; 5 pencils cost Rs 25.
recs.rel: One dozen = 12, a half dozen = 6, a gross = 144.

recs.q: A train covers 120 km in one hour. How much distance will it cover in 12 minutes?
recs.facts: 12 minutes = 1/5 hour, and 120/5 = 24 km.
recs.rel: 12 minutes is one fifth of an hour.

recs.q: After arranging the letters of RAPISS, it becomes the name of a country, city, ocean or state. Which one is it?
recs.facts: The word is a scrambled PARIS (the extra S in the source spelling is a typo), the capital city of France. So it is a city.
recs.rel: Anagram questions: look for a familiar name first, then check that every letter is used.

recs.q: Dog is to bitch as horse is to what?
recs.facts: A bitch is a female dog; the female horse is a mare.
recs.rel: Male horse: stallion; young horse: foal; young female: filly.

recs.q: If the 4th day of a month is Monday, what day will the 18th day be?
recs.facts: The gap is 14 days and 14 mod 7 = 0, so the day moves 0 step(s) ahead of Monday, which gives Monday.
recs.rel: Days: shift by the remainder after dividing the gap between the two dates by 7 (gap 7, 14, 21 gives the same day).

recs.q: If the 2nd day of a month is Friday, what day will the 14th day be?
recs.facts: The gap is 12 days and 12 mod 7 = 5, so the day moves 5 step(s) ahead of Friday, which gives Wednesday.
recs.rel: Days: shift by the remainder after dividing the gap between the two dates by 7 (gap 7, 14, 21 gives the same day).

recs.q: What will be the last letter of UTYEAB after arranging its letters alphabetically?
recs.facts: Alphabetical order is A, B, E, T, U, Y, so the last letter is Y.
recs.rel: Letters of the alphabet end with Z; Y is the later of the letters U, T, E, A, B, Y.

recs.q: What will be the 3rd letter of the word Managment when its letters are arranged alphabetically?
recs.facts: Letters of Managment: A, A, E, G, M, M, N, N, T in alphabetical order, so the 3rd letter is E. The source answer G is wrong (G is 4th). The same answer E applies to the correctly spelled MANAGEMENT.
recs.rel: Write the letters in order, keeping repeated letters, and count carefully.

recs.q: A person purchased a book for Rs 500 and sold it for Rs 700. What is the profit percentage?
recs.rel: Profit % is always calculated on the cost price.

recs.q: What is one tenth of 90?
recs.rel: One tenth means divide by 10, which moves the decimal one place left.

recs.q: What is one tenth of 120?
recs.rel: One tenth means divide by 10, which moves the decimal one place left.

recs.q: If yesterday was Monday, what day will be the day after tomorrow?
recs.facts: Yesterday Monday means today is Tuesday; tomorrow is Wednesday and the day after tomorrow is Thursday.
recs.rel: Day after tomorrow is 3 days after yesterday.

recs.q: If a helicopter needs 50 gallons of fuel to move 320 km, how many gallons will it need to move 400 km?
recs.facts: Fuel per km = 50/320; for 400 km: 50 x 400/320 = 62.5 gallons.
recs.rel: Direct proportion: more distance needs proportionally more fuel.

recs.q: Amjad and Ahmad kept 24 balls together. Amjad kept 3 times as many as Ahmad. How many balls did Ahmad keep?
recs.facts: Let Ahmad have x; Amjad has 3x, so 4x = 24 and x = 6.
recs.rel: For a ratio 1:3 the total has 4 parts; divide the total by 4.

recs.q: A boy is 3 years old and his sister is 3 times his age. How old will his sister be when the boy is 11 years old?
recs.facts: The sister is 9 now, so she is 6 years older. When the boy is 11, she is 17.
recs.rel: The age difference stays constant.

recs.q: What is 20% of one tenth of 90?
recs.facts: One tenth of 90 = 9; 20% of 9 = 1.8.
recs.rel: 20% is one fifth, so divide by 5.

recs.q: What is the sister of my brother's son to me?
recs.facts: My brother's son's sister is my brother's daughter, who is my niece.
recs.rel: Brother's or sister's son is a nephew; daughter is a niece.

recs.q: A boy has an average of 50 marks in 5 tests. How many marks must he score in the 6th test to raise his average to 70?
recs.facts: Total of 5 tests = 250. Total needed for 6 tests = 70 x 6 = 420. Next test = 420 - 250 = 170 (not possible if each test is out of 100, but this is the mathematical answer).
recs.rel: Needed score = new average x number of tests minus the current total.

recs.q: My age is 10 years and my brother is 2 times my age. What will be the ratio of my age to my brother's age after 10 years?
recs.facts: Brother is 20 now. After 10 years I am 20 and he is 30, so the ratio is 20:30 = 2:3 (the reverse order gives 3:2).
recs.rel: Add the same years to both ages before finding the ratio; never add years to the ratio itself.

recs.q: If the 3rd day of a month is Friday, what day will the 23rd day be?
recs.facts: The gap is 20 days and 20 mod 7 = 6, so the day moves 6 step(s) ahead of Friday, which gives Thursday.
recs.rel: Days: shift by the remainder after dividing the gap between the two dates by 7 (gap 7, 14, 21 gives the same day).

recs.q: Ali is 5 years old and his sister is 3 times his age. What will be the age of his sister when Ali is 10 years old?
recs.facts: The sister is 15 now, so she is 10 years older than Ali. When Ali is 10, she is 20.
recs.rel: The age difference stays constant.

recs.q: If the 4th day of a month is Tuesday, what day will the 12th day be?
recs.facts: The gap is 8 days and 8 mod 7 = 1, so the day moves 1 step(s) ahead of Tuesday, which gives Wednesday.
recs.rel: Days: shift by the remainder after dividing the gap between the two dates by 7 (gap 7, 14, 21 gives the same day).

recs.q: Saleem has an average of 60 in 4 subjects. His average drops to 58 after the next test. How many marks did he score in that test?
recs.facts: Total of 4 = 240. Total of 5 = 58 x 5 = 290. Next test = 290 - 240 = 50. (The source asks to find the grade; the marks are the only value that can be worked out.)
recs.rel: New test marks = new average x new count minus old total.

recs.q: 10 men dig a well in 5 days. How many days will 5 men take to dig it?
recs.facts: Work = 10 x 5 = 50 man-days; with 5 men: 50/5 = 10 days. The source answer 20 is wrong.
recs.rel: Fewer men take proportionally more days (inverse proportion): men x days = constant.

recs.q: Salman is 4 years old and Ali's age is twice Salman's age. What will be Ali's age when Salman is 12 years old?
recs.facts: Ali is 8 now, 4 years older than Salman. When Salman is 12, Ali is 16.
recs.rel: The age difference stays constant.

recs.q: Akbar is older than Ahmad. Umair is older than Akbar. Who is the eldest?
recs.facts: Order from eldest: Umair, Akbar, Ahmad.
recs.rel: Write the names in a line from oldest to youngest to solve ranking questions.

recs.q: Adil is 5 years old and his sister is 3 times his age. What will be the age of his sister when Adil is 15 years old?
recs.facts: Sister is 15 now, 10 years older than Adil. When Adil is 15, she is 25.
recs.rel: The age difference stays constant.

recs.q: What is 80% of 80?
recs.rel: 80% = 4/5, so divide by 5 and multiply by 4.

recs.q: What is 90% of 70?
recs.rel: 90% = whole minus 10 percent.

recs.q: Write the word formed from the numbers 18, 5, 19, 20 (A=1, B=2, and so on).
recs.facts: 18 = R, 5 = E, 19 = S, 20 = T, so the word is REST.
recs.rel: Position shortcuts: A=1, E=5, J=10, O=15, T=20, Z=26.

recs.q: The sister of my brother is your mother. What is your relation to me?
recs.facts: My brother's sister is my sister (taking me as male), and she is your mother, so I am your mother's brother and you are my nephew or niece.
recs.rel: Your mother's brother is your maternal uncle; his children's relation to you is cousin, and you are his nephew or niece.

recs.q: Adnan walks 10 meters towards the north, then towards the south. After this he turns back and then turns left. In which direction is he facing now?
recs.facts: After walking south he faces south; turning back he faces north; turning left from north he faces west.
recs.rel: Turning back means a 180 degree turn; left of north is west.

recs.q: A train covers 20 km in one hour. How much distance does it cover in 1 minute?
recs.facts: 20 km / 60 minutes = 1/3 km = 0.333 km. The printed answer 0.3 km is only a rounded value.
recs.rel: Km per minute = km/h divided by 60.

What is 80% of 10?
